name: Wind Walker
tagline: A Transcendent secondary weapon that hurls shurikens and rides the wind.
summary: Wind Walker is a Transcendent-grade secondary weapon released in South Korea on 27 June 2024. It uses 40-shuriken cartridges and can either launch shurikens to damage an area or deal damage in a cone in front of the user. Its Shuriken Storm skill spends 4 shurikens for a short-range burst, and Wind Boost automatically activates when the wind energy gauge is full, adding auto-targeting, a faster fire rate and a 360-degree attack mode in Zombie and Scenario modes.
description: Described by the wiki as a Secondary Weapon that uses 40-shuriken cartridges, able to launch shurikens for area damage or deal damage in a cone in front of the user. Right-click triggers Shuriken Storm, which consumes 4 shurikens to inflict damage in a shortened frontal range. Wind Boost activates automatically when all wind energy is fully charged, granting auto-targeting, increased fire rate and a 360-degree attack mode in Zombie/Scenario modes. Its design is based on the Tactical Knife and the shuriken-throwing mechanic was inspired by Genji from Overwatch. It was featured on the wiki main page as the 'New Transcendent Pistol'.
